% changebar given pdfTeX's driver option in its second spelling, PDFTeX,
% then loaded again with it, which is no clash. The text is the same as
% without the option.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[PDFTeX]{changebar}
\RequirePackage[PDFTeX]{changebar}
\begin{document}
Before the bar. \cbstart Inside the capitals' bar.\cbend{} After the bar.
\end{document}
